description: Figure 1 (e, f, g) of Meng et al. 2022 (arXiv:2202.05262) on GPT-2 XL for one prompt. The knockout extension: zero a ten-layer window of MLP outputs, attention outputs or residual-stream states at one token, one intervened forward per point. The paper's causal tracing: write the reference code's noise draw, numpy RandomState(1), then trace the restoration of every residual-stream state and of every ten-layer MLP and attention window over layer x token position. scripts/rome_fig1/knockout_figure.py draws the three knockout steps, scripts/rome_fig1/fig1_figure.py the two tracing steps.
